statement: The v7.3 f_uac2 configfs function supports playback/capture channel masks, sample-rate lists and sizes, mute/volume feature units, and playback/capture terminal-type configuration. Channel count is derived from channel-mask population in this pinned release, not separately configurable. Both data directions use isochronous endpoints. These are functional UAC2 configuration controls, not arbitrary composite descriptor or physical fidelity.

applicability.revision: Linux mainline v6.11, v6.12 or v7.3 as pinned; family revision unmeasured
applicability.scope: Linux UAC2 gadget-function options at pinned v7.3; later proposed channel-count patches are not presumed merged.
